text: Background: BK polyomavirus (BKV) reactivation occurs in 10–30% of kidney transplant recipients and can cause allograft nephropathy. Early virologic monitoring and reduction of immunosuppression remain central to management.
肾移植受者BK病毒（BKV）再激活与免疫抑制强度相关。定期监测血浆BK DNA载量，并结合移植物活检评估BKV肾病，是临床随访的常规策略。

Phage therapy has been explored as an adjunct for multidrug-resistant infections in solid organ transplant populations, including case series in kidney transplant recipients with refractory bacterial complications.
中国肾移植长期存活率提升后，机会性病毒感染（含BK病毒、CMV）与免疫维持方案平衡成为移植后管理重点；个体化减免疫策略需兼顾排斥风险。
